title: GREATER IS HE
WHO IS IN YOU
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: dark silhouette of an old stone watchtower against a starry midnight sky
flickering warm lantern light on a dark wooden prayer desk
deep indigo night sky with clouds moving over a crescent moon
calm dark lake reflecting distant constellations at midnight
soft golden light filtering through a gothic church window at night
glowing embers in a dark fireplace during the quiet of night

scenes.a: If you are wrestling with fear that feels larger than your faith, hear this truth.
The scripture says, You, dear children, are from God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.
Lord, at this midnight hour, remind us that the spirit dwelling within is stronger than any shadow.
Grant us the courage to release our heavy burdens into Your sovereign and loving hands tonight.
May Your peace guard our hearts and minds, silencing every whisper of doubt or lingering worry.
We rest securely in Your promise, confident that victory belongs to You alone, our faithful King.
